infracraft.msg.guide.title: ━━ Subway Building Guide ━━
infracraft.msg.guide.1: 1. Gather: shield machine, tunnel lining (64+), rails, tunnel lights, station blueprint
infracraft.msg.guide.2: 2. Survey: measure distance and height between stations with the surveyor
infracraft.msg.guide.3: 3. Descend: look down (40°+) while using the shield to bore a 1:1 ramp
infracraft.msg.guide.4: 4. Bore: each use cuts a 5×4 slice with lining, track (Create track first) and lights
infracraft.msg.guide.5: 5. Power: swap some lining under fast rails for redstone blocks
infracraft.msg.guide.6: 6. Station: stand on the track facing along the line and use the blueprint; with Create track, add a Create train station
infracraft.msg.guide.7: 7. Elevator: stand on it to rise to the surface; sneak to go down
infracraft.msg.guide.8: 8. Open: once a Create train runs between stations the route is surveyed automatically (vanilla carts too)
infracraft.msg.guide.9: 9. Run: schedule trains with Create, check /infra route, sneak-use a ticket at a station for express
infracraft.msg.guide.10: 10. Craft a book + rail to get this guide as a book
infracraft.book.subway.1:
━ Subway Handbook ━

Go underground!
This kit builds tunnels
and stations; trains
come from Create
(Create Fly) and its
addons.

Follow the next pages.
infracraft.book.subway.2:
1. Supplies

· Subway shield machine
· Tunnel lining 64+
  (8 stone + clay → 16)
· Create track
  (or vanilla rails)
· Tunnel lights
· Station blueprint
infracraft.book.subway.3:
2. Planning

Click both station sites
with the surveyor to get
distance and height.
Create track likes gentle
curves, so plan long
straight runs.
infracraft.book.subway.4:
3. Boring

Use the shield facing
forward: a 5×4 slice
with lining, track and a
light every 8 blocks.
Look down/up for a ramp.
Create track is used
first when you carry it.
infracraft.book.subway.5:
4. Water & lava

Lining is placed before
the slice is cleared, so
aquifers and lava stay
out. Bedrock and block
entities are left alone.
infracraft.book.subway.6:
5. Stations

Stand on the track facing
along the line and use
the blueprint: platforms,
lights and an elevator to
the surface. With Create
track, add a Create
train station.
infracraft.book.subway.7:
6. Running trains

Trains use Create
stations and schedules.
Each run between two
stations is surveyed for
/infra route, signposts
and express travel.
infracraft.book.subway.8:
7. More

/infra guide
/infra stations
/infra route "A" "B"
/infra network

Have a good trip!
